note: KOA Holiday off I-65 at 1960 Three Springs Road, Bowling Green. Spring-fed catfish pay lake (no license), pool in summer, mini golf, jumping pillow, dog park; cabins, covered wagons and tent sites as well. The cheapest sites are 30A water/electric pull-throughs the park calls best suited to pop-ups and vans, sloping slightly uphill. Some sites are let long-term. --Claude
summary: Kept (fees not re-read). koa.com's booking form was refused this session by Cloudflare, so the stored $41-155 (koa.com form for 2027-05-18, read 2026-10-19) stands unconfirmed; everything else read from KOA's own pages: year-round, 50A full hookups plus 30A water/electric, all pull-through, max 100 ft, Wi-Fi/laundry/store/bathhouse. Price-gate question on the $41 W/E sites (see flags). Not waterfront (pay pond only). Pin OK. Google 4.3/883.
flags: FEES NOT RE-READ: koa.com/campgrounds/bowling-green/reserve/ answered 'Performing security verification' / 'Just a moment...' (Cloudflare) on submit, twice, 2026-11-23; not solved or clicked through. Wayback has no reservation-results page. Fees group left as stored ($41-155 from the 2026-10-19 form read).

PRICE GATE (borderline, judgement): the only site type under $50 on the 2026-10-19 form read was '$41.00 avg/night' for 'Pull Thru, 30 Amps, Water/Electric', which KOA describes as 'best suited for pop-ups and vans. Sites slope slightly up hill if you need the entire length of the site.' The form did return it for a 23-ft motorhome. The next cheapest is $62 (30A full hookup) and $66 (50A); KOA Rewards' posted 10% would make $62 -> $55.80, still over $50. If the W/E sites don't count as a real 23-ft-rig night, this is a DROP CANDIDATE on price; no Good Sam Park (good_sam false), and gateways.py 36.91568,-86.43438 -> 'none within 40 km; nearest: Mammoth Cave NP 42 km'.

LONG-STAY: KOA blog posts 'Long-term RV rental sites at Bowling Green KOA Holiday' and 'Settle in for the season' exist but were Cloudflare-blocked; 14 of 15 RV site types were sold by the night online with no minimum, so tests 2-4 pass on what was read; not a home community.

PHONE: stored 800-562-2458 is KOA's reservation line; the park's own number is 270-843-1919 ('Info: 1-270-843-1919' on its amenities page; Google shows the same; the booking form says 'call (270) 843-1919'). Suggest phone 800-562-2458 -> 270-843-1919. Website https://koa.com/campgrounds/bowling-green/ current.

WATERFRONT: stored 'not waterfront' confirmed: Esri shows the RV rows south/southeast of the office between a subdivision and a wooded drainage; the only water is the ~1 ha catfish pay pond west of the office and a detention lake beyond a tree line to the SE.
PIN: stored 36.91568,-86.43438 is at the north end of the RV rows just south of the office (~150 m from the rows' centre). No move.
